notes.title: NOISZ reV3.0 (NOISZ FINAL pt.1 and Stellar Linkage)
notes.content:
A new major content and balance update, NOISZ reV3.0, has been released on Windows! This version brings the first part of the conclusion of the NOISZ series, accessible by entering a link code from the mobile game NOISZ STARLIVHT at the ending of NOISZ re:||VERSE, as well as the new Stellar Linkage DLC pack with 4 new songs, bringing wild new patterns and stage gimmicks.

(The Mac version will follow as soon as possible.)

Some long standing bugs and balance problems have been corrected; in particular, players will find that the default Core Module is substantially more powerful than before, but some unintended gameplay strategies are no longer as useful. The old mechanics are mostly preserved in the new "Rusted Core" module. Deprecated scores will be deprioritized on leaderboards, but your hard-earned grades will remain.

As always, thank you for playing! We're looking forward to bringing you an incredible ending to the series with NOISZ FINAL pt.2.

notes.title: [NOISZ reV3.0 coming soon] With the past revealed, the future begins to shift.
notes.content:
The NOISZ series approaches its finale with NOISZ reV3.0. As the first of two parts of NOISZ FINAL, an epilogue chapter to Story D will be unlocked by using a link code from [url=https://sl.noiszgame.com/]NOISZ STARLIVHT[/url]! The entire story of NOISZ SL can be played for free, and is continued alongside the story of NOISZ reV in this epilogue.

Additionally, some changes are being made to realign the game's scoring meta with its original design. Core Module will now function similarly to the Switch version of the game, applying a cap to the player's combo during iframes, and no longer has the "BPM armor" infamous in the community. A new? old? version of Core called "Rusted Core" will preserve the existing behavior, with most existing Core score records becoming Rusted. Rusted scores are ineligible for the leaderboards, and can be overwritten by any score with other modules, but grades obtained previously or after the update with Rusted Core will remain valid.

For the most hardcore players, the existence of a new module means that a new variant of Infinity Style will also appear. What could it be...?

Post update, conditions to reach the game's final extra stage and hidden song D.S. al fine will become easier. The epilogue chapter will also not have a score requirement in the credits game, unlike the post-credits scene which it replaces.

Finally, the new DLC Pack "Stellar Linkage" is also still under development. We're aiming to release it alongside the 3.0 update, but it's possible that it may release shortly after this February's Steam Next Fest, as we're also working on a demo of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2978440/PROJEKT_GODHAND/]next game, PROJEKT GODHAND[/url] for the event.

Thanks for reading, and for following us on this long journey. Let's look forward to the future of NOISZ together!

This short campaign features 6 new songs and the all-new Proto Style, a wild new twist on NOISZ's gameplay which can also be used outside of the epG content.

For the first week after launch, it's also 11% off! Why not Give it a try. Or something. Look, I save all my good writing for the game, so deal with it.

notes.title: NOISZ reV2.4 (The New Engine Update)
notes.content:
It's been a while, hasn't it...? For NOISZ's 5th anniversary, we've rebuilt the game in GMS2! It's hard to convey just how much effort has gone into this undertaking, so we'll just focus on what that means for everyone else...

In most cases, you can expect substantial performance gains relative to older versions of the game! It's also made it possible to bring back the Mac version, along with a certain other heavily-anticipated port which... isn't quite ready yet for the occasion, but it's coming soon!

Please note that the revamped first-boot sequence (normally shown to new players) will appear for everyone once, so your data is safe!

The demo has also been updated, so prospective players will experience the same changes.

In any case, thank you all for playing NOISZ! I'd say something like "here's to 5 more years", but we're looking to bring the series to its finale soonish. Please look forward to an epic conclusion instead...!?

(And of course, next month, we'll be launching a new story DLC for the game, NOISZ episode G! Please wishlist it if you'd like...!)

notes.title: NOISZ reV2.3 (The Big Story and Accessibility Update)
notes.content:
NOISZ reV2.3 has been released, bringing a number of new accessibility and QoL features, as well as a rewrite of the game's original campaign, NOISZ Ignition!

[b]Updated Story[/b]
NOISZ Ignition features tighter writing and connects more seamlessly to its successors, re:||VERSE and STΔRLIVHT. It's an improved experience for newcomers, and worth discovering all over again for veterans!

[b]New Accessibility Functions[/b]
Two new assist features have been added: Super Easy mode grants complete invincibility throughout the entire story campaign, while Route Assist automatically selects all dialogue choices which have a significant impact on the story, guaranteeing you the ending of your choice (if your rhythm bullet hell skills are up to the task, at least).

These features will help players struggling with the bullet hell and VN aspects of the game, respectively; Dancer Style, which has been in the game from its initial release, is an assist feature for its rhythm element. Choose to engage with the parts of NOISZ that appeal to you! You can even turn on all three, kick back, and just enjoy the story.

[b]Speedrun Challenges[/b]
Another special Story Mode variant Luna Rush has been added, which is all about going fast! But also not dying! Each stage is timed, and to stop the clock, you'll want to reach Overflow as quickly as possible. But you'll permanently have Lunatic Module equipped, causing you to restart the Verse on taking damage! A wild new challenge for our mightiest veterans.

[b]Base Game QoL Updates[/b]
Several features included with the re:||VERSE expansion have been backported to the base game! Notably, Style Lab is available, letting you customize your abilities before battle!

[b]Massively Expanded Demo[/b]
You can now play the entirety of Story A for free in NOISZ's demo! Tell all your friends to try it out~

notes.title: NOISZ reV2.2 (Anniversary Update): Now in Japanese
notes.content:
NOISZ re:||VERSE is now 1 year old! We're celebrating with a new update that brings full Japanese support, as well as some smaller fixes and balance changes. We'll be working to bring NOISZ to you in more languages in the future as well!

Quick changelog:
[list]
[*] reV Story and UI localized to Japanese
[*] Parry variants with 1 max life no longer keep combo on reaching Overflow with exactly 64 combo
[*] reV (stage) pattern difficulty reduced on Easy and Normal, boss HP -5%
[*] Quicksilver boss HP in verse 2 -10% and verse timer more reliable, player damage output +10%
[*] In π・ρ・maniac, using Harmonic's red shield will cause you to take damage from the correct answer laser (and not the wrong answer). Score saving on this stage has now been enabled for Harmonic
[/list]

notes.title: NOISZ v2.1 Performance Update
notes.content:
NOISZ's performance update is now live, addressing start of stage and intermittent lag issues! This version should cover the most common performance problems players have experienced, and we hope it ensures a smooth experience for you.

If you encounter any new problems relating to the update, please let us know! You can use the "legacy" build (in the betas menu) to switch back to the previous version if needed.

notes.title: Performance Test Beta
notes.content:
In order to address performance issues that some players are experiencing, we've been working on some engine changes, and we need your help to determine whether we're on the right track. If you've encountered lag or stutters in the game (especially if it affects stage patterning), please try out this beta build and let us know if it improves performance for you!

Right-click NOISZ in your Steam library, hit "Properties", then select pftest as in the image below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30522987/c108547d903be8e2050bcbd81cd13a6fda3afa2f.png[/img]

If you encounter any problems unique to this build, also let us know ASAP if you can.

We hope these changes will allow us to bring the proper NOISZ experience to all players!

notes.title: Introducing: NOISZ STΔRLIVHT
notes.content:
With the re:||VERSE expansion completed, NOISZ is now a massive game boasting 34 total stages (a huge amount for any shmup) and a full-fledged VN story so big, it'd count as a novel by NaNoWriMo standards (around 53k words total).

We're hoping you love what we've done so far... and what we're cooking up next:

[previewyoutube=Y7O13gCQQSQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We're reimagining NOISZ's gameplay for touchscreen, and starting a brand new standalone story. We've learned a lot in the process of creating our first independent work, and we're confident that we'll be able to use that experience to make STΔRLIVHT an even better game!

We'd love for you to join us on our next journey! If you're excited by what you see, watch [url=https://twitter.com/noiszgame]our Twitter[/url] for updates. We'll be posting character bios weekly, and will reveal the new gameplay and 1st single in April!

notes.title: NOISZ release dated for 8/31!
notes.content:
Mark your calendars! NOISZ's unique mix of rhythm game, bullet hell shmup, and visual novel is getting its full release on 8/31.

Featuring a lineup of 16 hard-hitting tracks, challenging boss fights with unique mechanics in each stage, deep and fun scoring mechanics that provide tens of hours of intense gameplay, several gameplay styles that you can choose between to suit the situation or your personal preference, a story packed with colorful characters and surprising twists, and even dance pad support--NOISZ fuses its component genres to become unlike anything else you've ever played.

The game has been in Early Access for almost a year, and we're excited to be bringing the complete experience to you soon!
